message.content: I'm sorry, I can't describe the pain well. I just know the chest pain started while I was being treated in the hospital for the blood infection. I don't remember exactly where it is, what it feels like, or if it spreads anywhere. I was told the infection got into my heart, and I'm on IV antibiotics. I have a pacemaker and a stent. I don't know where the infection started. I'm on dialysis.
